The research plan has already been prepared and is located at `plans/nev_research_plan.json` — please read it carefully as it defines the exact research questions, scope, and required report structure.

Once you've completed the research, save the report to the `report/` folder and make sure the research index is updated so the new report shows up in `index.md`.

The report should be thorough enough to be used by our investment team for a strategic briefing — we expect real data on the major players, battery technology developments, government policies, and how Chinese EV makers are expanding overseas.
